claim: Austria's competition authority (BWB) was notified of DKS's acquisition of Foot Locker, Inc. as case BWB/Z-6981 on 2025-06-24. Neither the BWB nor the Federal Cartel Prosecutor asked the Cartel Court to examine it, so the deal was cleared in Phase I with no remedies and the standstill ended 2025-07-23. No European merger-control condition forced a disposal of FL Europe.
data_point: BWB/Z-6981; notified 24.06.2025; deadline for a Cartel Court application 22.07.2025; standstill ended 23.07.2025; NACE G 47.71
source_name: Bundeswettbewerbsbehoerde (BWB) merger register, announcement under s.10 Cartel Act
original_quote: The Federal Competition Authority and the Federal Cartel Prosecutor have not applied for examination of the merger by the Cartel Court. The standstill obligation (§ 17 (1) Cartel Act) ends with effect from 23.07.2025.
verifier_note: Verifier opened the page in a browser on 2026-10-07 (scripted requests get a Sucuri JS redirect). The case number, notification date, sector codes, 22.07.2025 deadline and quoted text all match. Downgraded A to B: this is context, not exit evidence. The baseline already has 'foreign antitrust clearances required' and 'all required regulatory approvals received' plus the $100M divestiture cap. What is new is the named jurisdiction and the clean Phase I clearance.

claim: The Austrian BWB register holds 695 notifications from 2025-01-02 to 2026-10-07 (374 in 2025 and 321 in 2026, the latest BWB/Z-7511 on 07.10.26). The only one involving Foot Locker is the DKS/FL deal itself. There is no notification of any acquisition of FL Europe, FL Austria or other FL entities or stores. Nearby sector filings: ANTA/Puma (BWB/Z-7305, 27.04.26) and Frasers/ASOS (BWB/Z-7451, 18.08.26).
data_point: 1 of 695 notifications names Foot Locker (Z-6981, DKS as acquirer); 0 with FL as target
source_name: BWB merger register, 2025 and 2026 'All' lists (verifier recount)
original_quote: BWB/Z-6981 Dick's Sporting Goods, Inc.; Foot Locker, Inc. 24.06.25 Expiration of the deadline
verifier_note: Verifier recount through the register's own list endpoint gave 374 rows for 2025 and 321 for 2026, with 0 FL-as-target hits; the sector hits matched (Decathlon Pulse x2, PONDS/Leder & Schuh, ANTA/Puma, Frasers/ASOS). Downgraded A to B because the negative is weaker than the scraper claims. (1) A buyer with EU-dimension turnover (e.g. JD or Frasers) would file with the European Commission under the one-stop shop, not the BWB. (2) A licence or franchise conversion, or the sale of a few stores, may not count as a notifiable concentration. (3) There can be a gap between signing and filing. The Austrian domestic threshold for a buyer with no Austrian presence (FL Austria has only 6 stores) is outside knowledge and was not verified.

claim: Poland's competition office (UOKiK) registered DKS's takeover of Foot Locker, Inc. as case DKK-2.421.49.2025.RAW (filed 2025-06-24) and cleared it by decision DKK-184/2025 of 2025-07-24. With Austria, this is the deal's European merger-control trail. Inference: regimes that need turnover from both parties (Germany, the EC, etc.) were not triggered because DKS had no European turnover.
original_quote: Przejęcie przez Dick's Sporting Goods, Inc. z siedzibą w Coraopolis, Stany Zjednoczone, kontroli nad Foot Locker, Inc. z siedzibą w Nowym Jorku, Stany Zjednoczone. STAN SPRAWY: Sprawa zakończona decyzja DKK-184/2025 z dn. 24.07.2025 r.
english_translation: Acquisition by Dick's Sporting Goods, Inc. of Coraopolis, United States, of control over Foot Locker, Inc. of New York, United States. CASE STATUS: Case closed by decision DKK-184/2025 of 24.07.2025.
verifier_note: Verifier fetched the page on 2026-10-07 and the case number, filing date, decision number and date all match; the BIP entry is dated 2025-07-02. Downgraded A to B as clearance-trail context. The double-turnover inference is the scraper's and was not verified, though it fits the absence of FL in the 2025 Bundeskartellamt list.

claim: The European Commission's decision M.11159 (JD Sports/Groupe Courir, 22.10.2024) puts Foot Locker at 145 stores in France at the time of drafting, against 384 for JD and Courir combined after the deal (Snipes 34). Market participants ranked Foot Locker and Snipes as the parties' closest competitors. Across Belgium, Denmark, France, the Netherlands, Portugal and Spain, JD and Courir have 920 stores, 'almost four times' Foot Locker (inference: about 230-250 FL stores in those six countries). In local catchments FL runs 4 stores in Porto Arrábida and 7 in Lisbon Chiado, and its share of leisure sports footwear is mostly in the 0-5% to 10-20% ranges.
country: France, Portugal, Spain, Belgium, Netherlands, Denmark
data_point: FL France 145 stores (EC, Oct-2024) vs JD+Courir 384; JD+Courir 920 in 6 EEA countries, about 4x FL
source_name: European Commission merger decision M.11159, public version, C(2024) 7525 final
original_quote: Post-Transaction, the Parties will have a total of 384 stores in France. By way of comparison, Foot Locker and Snipes combined would represent only 179 stores in France (145 for Foot Locker and 34 for Snipes).
verifier_note: Verifier downloaded the 141-page PDF and extracted the text. Paras 302-303 (the 145/34/384 counts), para 145 (FL and Snipes ranked closest competitors), the 920 stores 'almost four times more than its close competitor Foot Locker' line, and paras 346 and 351 (Porto Arrábida: FL 4 stores; Lisbon Chiado: FL 7) all match; the decision is dated Brussels, 22.10.2024. Downgraded A to B: the data is pre-deal and structural, and the France locator series is already in confirmed. The EC's 145 is below the 2024 locator's 146-150, so the formats counted likely differ. The catchment counts overlap and must not be summed.

claim: The verifier re-scanned 538 Polish UOKiK register entries with detail pages (published 2025-01-10 to 2026-10-07). The only one naming Foot Locker is the DKS/FL deal. No acquisition of FL Poland, FL Europe or FL stores has been notified. Footwear-related entries are CCC S.A./MKRI (2025-08-14), ANTA, Kontoor/ABG (Lee), PGD Polska and W.Kruk, none involving FL.
data_point: 0 of 538 UOKiK entries (2025-01-10 to 2026-10-07) have FL as target
verifier_note: Verifier crawled list pages 1-55 and every detail page on 2026-10-07 (538 entries; the scraper had 490 over a shorter window), searching for foot locker, atmos, snipes and obuwi; the only FL hit is dicks-sporting-goods-inc. The scraper's CCC/MKRI decision DKK-254/2025 of 06.11.2025 was not verified (the BIP entry is dated 2025-08-14). Downgraded A to B for the same reasons as the BWB scan: EU-dimension deals go to the EC, licence conversions or small asset deals may not be notifiable, and there is a signing-to-filing lag. FL Poland has only 12 stores.

claim: The Bundeskartellamt's archive of mergers notified in 2025 (35-page PDF, covering January to December 2025) has no Foot Locker entry, so DKS/FL was not filed in Germany. The only footwear or sporting-goods entries are Heartland/Sports Group Denmark, Arklyz/Gabor Shoes and Adiuva/Kuebler Sport. The 2026 German list was not checked.
data_point: 0 'Foot'/'Locker' hits in the 2025 archive PDF (~750-810 case numbers)
verifier_note: Verifier downloaded the PDF (HTTP 200, 35 pages, dates spanning every month of 2025): 0 hits for 'Foot' or 'Locker', and the single 'Dick' hit is 'Dickenpruefung'. The case-number count is about 750-813, not the scraper's 865 entries. Tier C: the archive covers only 2025, almost all before or just after the close, so it says little about a 2026 sale. 2026 is unverified.

data_point: 1 new store (Sendai PARCO, first in Tohoku) plus 1 flagship renewal (Ginza, 2026-01-31)
